notes.title: Become the delivery drone you always wanted to be in Supfly Delivery Simulator
notes.notes:
Supfly Delivery Simulator is a name that doesn't leave much to the imagination, set in a world where humanity is ruled by delivery service it's your time to shine.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/become-the-delivery-drone-you-always-wanted-to-be-in-supfly-delivery-simulator

notes.title: Deliver now! Supfly Delivery Simulator is now available!
notes.notes:
You can definetely imagine what drones are. But have you ever thought about drones that can deliver cargos. It sounds like something futiristic. Probably we’ll have to wait a few more years until the drones will be used in delivery. But you don’t need to wait to see how it could be in the future.

 And that’s what our game is about - we can proudly announce that we are launching a new game!

[h2]We are already on Steam:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403350/Supfly_Delivery_Simulator/

The rules are simple so as the gameplay.  Your job is to deliver the cargos using a drone. But be careful. You have to remember to take care of battery. If it runs out, you’ll be in trouble. You also need to make sure about your time-keeping – you don’t want your clients to be mad.
You can play solo (you can freely fly with your drone), career mode (your road yo be the best deliveryboy in town) or compete with your friend to see who is better in delivery. 
Ability to play together adds a lot of competition to this game. You and your friend will need to do your best to beat each other – the game will be full of emotions. But only one of you will be the winner.


[u]The main in-game features that you can notice are:[/u]
[list]
[*] - 3 different maps that are automatically generated
[*] - weather conditions
[*] - different types of cargos
[*] - ability to choose a drone
[/list]

Be careful! This game is very, very addictive and you’ll probably spend many hours playing it.


For some extra information you can contact us here: marketing@source-byte.com
